items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Vernon Alley was bass player in that particular band. ... Of course, he was with our Navy band, of which I was the leader, during World War II at St. Mary's Pre-Flight School.

ctx.x: ~~ (Inaudible) ~~ The other thing I wanted to ask you. I found this picture from a magazine -- I don't know what the magazine was, but it's ~~ a ~~ in Jerome Richardson's scrapbook and it's a picture of your Navy band and I wonder if you

I can tell you the name of most of them right offhand. Starting from the left, piano player is Wilbur Branoo (PHONETIC). He's a teacher up at the University of California now. Standing next to him is Vernon Alley, excellent bassist and a stalwart San Franciscan. Then the guitar player is Benny -- I can't think of his last name. He has since passed. Tenor saxophone player in the front there is Andy Anderson out of Cleveland, Ohio. Next to him is Q. Dellis Martin (PHONETIC), who is now living in Honolulu. Next to…
The leader is standing there, right?
